Home Offerings Approach Investment Book Connect

Begin where you are. Be guided with steady clarity.

I offer thoughtful, confidential therapy that centers your inner knowing. If you are exploring anxiety, relationship change, grief, or life transitions, we will work together to create practical, values-aligned steps that honor your full life.

{{THERAPIST_NAME}}, {{LICENSE}}
{{MODALITIES}} • {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}

Sessions are private, collaborative, and time-limited when helpful. I practice within ethical boundaries: I do not prescribe medication and will coordinate care if you need psychiatric consultation or crisis support.

Get in touch

Or call: {{PHONE}} • Email: {{EMAIL}}

How I work — a brief diagnostic map

We begin by clarifying what matters to you: symptoms that interfere with daily life, relational patterns, and values you want to live by. From there I offer a clear plan with measurable checkpoints.

Step 1 — Listen

A focused intake to understand history, strengths, and immediate concerns.

Step 2 — Map

A shared formulation that links your patterns to practical, compassionate strategies.

Step 3 — Integrate

Small experiments and adjustments you can practice between sessions.

Step 4 — Evaluate

We recalibrate together and plan next steps or referrals as needed.

Session structure — a steady frame

Typical sessions are 50 minutes. The rhythm is practical and reflective: check-in, work on targeted interventions, and a closing plan. Telehealth and limited in-person availability. Cancellation policy: please provide 48 hours notice.

Micro-practices to try now

  • 1) Three breaths before responding to a hard message.
  • 2) A 5-minute end-of-day review: what went well, one adjustment for tomorrow.
  • 3) Grounding: name five things you can see, four you can touch.

These are gentle invitations — we adapt practices to your life rather than add obligations.

Investment — clarity and optional pathways

I offer single sessions, short-term focused packages, and ongoing care. Sliding scale and limited pro-bono spots available by application.

Single Session

A one-off 50-minute consultation to address an immediate need.

Short Focus Path

6-session commitment for a targeted outcome (communication, grief, habit change).

Ongoing Care

Weekly or biweekly sessions for deeper relational or trauma work.

Community Cohort

A small-group learning format for skills, not psychotherapy. (Different scope.)

Exact fees are shared during initial contact. Insurance is not accepted directly; I provide superbills on request.

Ready to begin?

If this feels like the right fit, reach out via the form or click to schedule a time. I aim to respond within 48 hours on business days.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} See available times

Confidentiality note: Sessions are held in a secure platform or private office; records are maintained in accordance with professional standards. I will not share information without your written consent except where required by law (e.g., imminent risk of harm, abuse reporting).

Crisis disclaimer: I am not an emergency service. If you are in immediate danger, please call local emergency services or go to the nearest emergency room. If you are within the United States and need urgent help, dial or text 988 for the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.
